description: Defines classes and constants for handling METADATA frames in HTTP/2 extensions, including a visitor for parsing METADATA frames and a sequence class for serializing METADATA blocks.

classes.name: MetadataVisitor
classes.description: Implements an interface to parse METADATA frames in HTTP/2, supporting support detection and payload processing.

classes.name: MetadataFrameSequence
classes.description: Serializes a METADATA block into a sequence of HTTP/2 METADATA frames using HPACK encoding.

methods.name: MetadataVisitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing callbacks for payload and support detection.

methods.name: OnSetting
methods.description: Handles HTTP/2 setting frames to detect support for METADATA extension.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Processes frame headers to identify METADATA frames.

methods.name: OnFramePayload
methods.description: Processes payload data of METADATA frames.

methods.name: PeerSupportsMetadata
methods.description: Checks if the peer has advertised support for METADATA.

methods.name: MetadataFrameSequence
methods.description: Constructs a sequence for serializing a METADATA block.

methods.name: HasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more frames to serialize.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next serialized METADATA frame.
